title: Nov 18-24: World Antimicrobial Awareness Week
content: Features and Highlights 2026 2025 2024 2023 2022 2021 2020 2019 2018 2017 2016 &nbspPrevious Article Next Article Nov 18-24: World Antimicrobial Awareness Week 11/17 Since the discovery of penicillin, researchers have developed better and better antibiotics to fight microbial infection. Bacteria, in turn, have evolved more and more effective ways of resisting these drugs: by destroying them, by pumping them out, or by modifying the target of the drug. Atomic structures help us understand resistance to antibiotics and develop new ways to fight infection. PDB-101 hosts a variety of related materials, including Molecule of the Month features, videos, posters, and more . Download the Superbugs poster or use the interactive animation to explore the protein structures that medical researchers are utilizing to search for ways to fight superbugs likes MRSA (Methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus Aureus).
